verdict.rationale: Error reporting on failed conversions is a fair question for a media conversion tool, but nothing in the evidence pack documents how FFmpeg reports failures, such as unsupported features or corrupt input. Community reports of black video stretches and lost color information describe output fidelity problems, not documented failure diagnostics, so they give no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, a failed conversion reports why it failed (unsupported feature, corrupt input) instead of silently emitting a broken file
